content.short: THX Network boosts engagement and helps create new revenue streams with a widget for onboarding and rewarding users.
content.description: THX Network offers a ready-to-use widget that helps onboard new users and reward ongoing activity and engagement. This creates vibrant community experiences and partnerships while helping projects reduce customer acquisition costs and lift lifetime value. The solution runs on a battle-tested loyalty API alongside the Polygon blockchain. With the embeddable widget, you can quickly launch your own tokenized loyalty network. See the widget in action on THX Network’s site for details about loyalty points, perks, and partnerships.
